info.name: APV entry accounting
info.description: APV entry accounting with forward-only legacy compatibility. New APVs require balanced four-decimal entries and payable reconciliation, except liquidation (including the excess alias) creation accepts omitted entries or []. Liquidation updates always require a supplied nonempty valid entries array, including legacy vouchers. Null/string entries are invalid; approval still requires valid accounting entries. Existing approved/open/closed vouchers without entry history remain payable; first approval or financial changes require explicit entries. No historical backfill or rebuild is part of deployment. Write examples are documentation and must not be used as live rollout tests. Aged-payables JSON and Excel use the same complete approved, active, positive-balance voucher population as get_all?screen=for_payment, including active shared centers. Reports use current balances; as_of_date controls ageing only, not historical balances. Patient names follow branch-aware APV decryption; missing names remain null.

request.description: Required nonempty entries; balanced debit1120/credit1120. Net credit to account code201-111 equals header1110. Populate account placeholders with active master IDs. JSON or multipart entries[n][field] supported; optional attachments[] retain existing behavior.

request.description: Linked approved direct payment must have duration_from/to and amount1000. Explicit amortization allocations sum its amount; expense/prepaid accounts are never inferred from payable credits. Monthly journals wait for closed APV, preserve historical periods, and deduplicate by direct payment/date.

Reconcile against every page of accounts_payable_vouchers/get_all?screen=for_payment (not just its first page). Active approved vouchers with positive stored balance only. Master queried once for all active shared centers; optional branch_id isolates a clinic or actual shared ID. No pagination on the report. as_of_date changes ageing buckets only, never reconstructs historical balances. Existing fields/formatting are retained. Detail includes branch-qualified voucher identities; patients with identical numeric IDs in different branches remain separate. Analysis has no current field, so its first 1_month bucket includes current plus 1_month amounts. Excel uses this same report dataset. Optional supplier_type=supplier|payor|patient filters all payees of that type. supplier_id must be a positive integer and requires supplier_type; empty filters are ignored. Filters affect all report tabs, totals, percentages, and Excel. Summary suppliers now include supplier_type; detail retains it, while analysis stays category-grouped.
